items.html: And below it will be explained that the coronet of Gevura, all of it or most of it, is given to the Nukva; and the coronet of Hesed, all of it or most of it, is given to ZA; and what remains of the coronet of Hesed is drawn into his Yesod and given there. And there stands that Hesed that descended there; therefore the Yesod of Bina is not purified here, but only its Netzah and Hod — and these are the two straps, the right and the left.
